query:
SELECT
                sub_post.title,
                sub_post.score,
                sub_post.nsfw,
                sub_post.posted,
                sub.name "sub",
                sub.nsfw "sub_nsfw",
                u.name "user_name!"
            FROM sub_post
            INNER JOIN sub ON sub.sid = sub_post.sid
            INNER JOIN "user" AS u ON u.uid = sub_post.uid
            WHERE sub_post.posted > $1 AND sub_post.nsfw = FALSE AND sub_post.deleted = 0
            ORDER BY score DESC
            LIMIT 5
